test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

My coach said, “You should take a healthy diet.”

options.text: My coach told me that I should have taken a healthy diet.
My coach told me that I should take a healthy diet.
My coach told me that you should take a healthy diet.
My coach said that I shall take a healthy diet.

solution:
The correct answer is **'My coach told me that I should take a healthy diet.'**
